There is no clientSecret parameter here any more, and main.bicep no longer
declares one. The Graph client secret is written to Key Vault ONCE by
infra/bootstrap.bicep; this routine template only references the vault.
Passing clientSecret= to main.bicep now fails with 'the following
parameters were supplied but not declared'. That is the intended behaviour:
the routine deployment path cannot carry a secret even by accident.
PREREQUISITE: infra/bootstrap.bicep must have been run against this resource
group first. main.bicep looks up the Key Vault and the managed identity as
'existing' resources and fails loudly if they are not there.
location is omitted on purpose - main.bicep defaults it to the resource
group's own region. Pinning it here is how the group ended up created in a
graphTenantId is the MICROSOFT 365 tenant that owns the Graph app
registration and the SharePoint site - NOT the Azure tenant that owns the
subscription these resources deploy into. They are different directories;
using the Azure one here deploys fine and then fails every Graph call.
